name: Vitnyéd (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, blue, red and green, charged near the top of the red with the municipal arms of Vitnyéd (a blue shield with a fish, a sun and a crescent above a wavy stripe) above the name VITNYÉD in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
